# Stanic Lab — Reproductive Immunology
> University of Wisconsin-Madison, Dept. of Obstetrics and Gynecology
> Led by Dr. Aleksandar Stanic-Kostic (MD, PhD)
> Associate Professor with Tenure | Vice Chair for Research | Division Director, Reproductive Sciences

## Pages
- [Home](index.html): Lab overview, mission, research highlights, team preview
- [People](people.html): Team members, collaborator network, alumni
- [Research](research.html): Research directions, publications, methods, model systems
- [News](news.html): Lab news, UW OB/GYN news mirror, photo gallery, timeline

## Research Themes
1. **Decidual Immune Regulation** — T cells, innate lymphoid cells, and immune-vascular crosstalk at the maternal-fetal interface
2. **PCOS Immune Mechanisms** — Ovarian-specific inflammation and immunometabolic profiling
3. **Preeclampsia Immunopathology** — Immune-endothelial crosstalk and checkpoint dysregulation
4. **Tissue Architecture &amp; Injury** — Quantitative, multi-modal investigation of placental and decidual biology
5. **Translational Platforms** — MPS, digital pathology, AI/ML, and new approach methodologies

## Key Methods
- Visium FFPE Spatial Transcriptomics
- CITE-seq (simultaneous protein + RNA)
- Spectral Flow Cytometry (18+ colors)
- Microphysiological Systems (vessel-on-chip)
- Digital Histopathology / QuPath
- AI/ML Multi-Omic Integration

## Model Systems
- Rhesus Macaque (cross-gestational sampling)
- Human (clinical samples, biomarker validation)
- Mouse (genetic manipulation, fate mapping)
- MPS/Vessel-on-chip (therapeutic testing)
